sections.title: UNITS
sections.body: Every operator belongs to one unit. You pick it during verification and can change it any time in <#1542515113347649606>.

sections.title: ⚔️  GROUND UNIT
sections.body: The main assault force. Fireteams, breaching, holding ground. Most operators are here, and most new joins should start here.

sections.title: 🎯  SNIPER UNIT
sections.body: Overwatch, recon and long range support. Works in pairs, reports to the op lead, and opens the fight from where nobody is looking.

sections.title: SPECIALISATIONS
sections.body: These stack on top of your unit and your rank. Ask an NCO or Command for one.

fields.name: Primary Pilot and Reserve Pilot
fields.value: Transport, insertion and air support. Reserve flies when Primary is not on.

fields.name: Medic
fields.value: Keeps the unit in the fight. Patches people up, and calls the extraction when they cannot be.

fields.name: JTAC
fields.value: The ground operator who talks to the pilots and calls the air in. This is what makes air support real.
